verdict.rationale: A local model-serving engine could plausibly ship a one-command launcher for third-party coding agent CLIs, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents one. The OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages API endpoints are building blocks a user could wire up manually; they are not a pre-configured single-command agent launch.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command
